newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Sanacorp new shares priced at 30-35 marks.
newsitem.headline: German Sanacorp new shares priced at 30-35 marks.

text.p: German pharmaceutical group Sanacorp Pharmahandel AG on Monday said it planned to sell around two million new shares in a public offering, with the bookbuilding price range set at 30 to 35 marks per share.
The bookbuilding phase will run until October 18, Sanacorp told a news conference on Monday and the final price will be set on October 21.
Sanacorp plans to list the five-mark nominal value shares on the Frankfurt stock exchange. The issue is being managed by a consortium led by DG Bank.
